text.offer: Princess Kateriina says, "Ko'catan's captain has read my letters; now he must sign. Take him the treaty: Cital ko'Manca keeps the East Tower by day. By night another captain holds it, and he is no friend of ours. Cital will want proof the crown can keep its friends safe, so clear the avars from the jungle paths while you are there."
text.progress: Cital ko'Manca keeps the East Tower in Ko'catan by day, from the eighth hour to the twentieth; by night Xacal ko'Ixca holds it, and he will not sign. The avars roam the jungle beyond.
text.complete: Princess Kateriina says, "Ko'catan stands with the crown. With their ships behind us, I name you one of my Captains. See the war through with me and rise to Champion, and you shall have my gift."

steps.objective: Take the treaty to Cital ko'Manca in Ko'catan, by day
steps.brief: Cital ko'Manca keeps the East Tower in Ko'catan by day, from the eighth hour to the twentieth. By night Xacal ko'Ixca holds it: come back in the morning.

steps.objective: Avars on the jungle paths slain
steps.brief: The captain will sign once the jungle paths are safe: ten avars.
